name: 13_surveyor_mid
setup: const r = g.world.goto ? g.world.goto('intake') : null; const p=(r&&r.position)||g.world.spawn; const y=((r&&r.yaw!==undefined)?r.yaw:(g.world.spawnYaw||0)); const o = g.lookAtOpen(p, y, 0); const q=g.gameplay&&g.gameplay.qa; if(q&&q.surveyorTo){ const f=g.player.forward(); q.surveyorTo(g.player.position.x+f.x*10, g.player.position.z+f.z*10, {state:'SEEKING'}); }

name: 14_surveyor_close
setup: const r = g.world.goto ? g.world.goto('intake') : null; const p=(r&&r.position)||g.world.spawn; const y=((r&&r.yaw!==undefined)?r.yaw:(g.world.spawnYaw||0)); const o = g.lookAtOpen(p, y, 0.04); const q=g.gameplay&&g.gameplay.qa; if(q&&q.surveyorTo){ const f=g.player.forward(); q.surveyorTo(g.player.position.x+f.x*4.5, g.player.position.z+f.z*4.5, {state:'MEASURING'}); }
